name: US equity stress
summary: VIX 18.7 and S&P 500 2.9% below its high on 12 Nov; both inside Normal lines
state: The VIX closed near 18.7 on 12 Nov, below the 20 Watch line and 27% lower on the week (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 was near 7,592, 2.9% below its 52-week high of 7,819 and 2.9% higher on the week; its worst session of the past five fell 0.4%. Both readings sit inside the Normal lines.
for_you: US equity volatility is at background levels. Pension and investment values linked to US shares are close to their highs.
rubric_hit: VIX 19.8 below the 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 3.62% below the 5% Watch line
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
